notes: Two branches («ح» between them), each its own group; «قالا حدثنا شعبة، عن الأعمش، بهذا الإسناد» is written once after both, so it is the shared tail (rule 3).
«- يعني ابن جعفر -» is an editor gloss, left out.
«مثل حديث جرير» names another transmitter: a variant group, never a route (rule 4). «وزاد» adds wording, left out.
